description: This file declares the UserIdManager class, which manages user IDs and group IDs associated with applications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It provides methods to retrieve user IDs, clear user IDs, and get application GIDs, along with private members for UID range management and synchronization.

classes.name: UserIdManager
classes.description: Manages user IDs and group IDs for applications, providing methods to retrieve and clear user IDs, and to get application GID within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with a given application ID.

methods.name: clearUserId
methods.description: Clears the stored user ID for a specified application ID.

methods.name: getAppsGid
methods.description: Retrieves the group ID associated with applications.

methods.name: getAppsUidRange
methods.description: Private method to get the range of valid user IDs.
